## A3. Exact-boundary items (threshold_cross, date_cross; test)

## A6. Is the cross-reference label decidable from the article number alone? (all splits)

Items containing a cross-reference sentence: 520; of these, naming the case's own category: 520; cross-reference sentences outside `xref_redirect` pairs: 0.

| Refers to Article 1 | Negative claim | Gold label | Items |
|---|---|---|---|
| False | False | entailed | 136 |
| False | True | contradicted | 124 |
| True | False | contradicted | 136 |
| True | True | entailed | 124 |

If the label is a deterministic function of (refers to Article 1, claim polarity), a model can solve every cross-reference item without checking the category or resolving the reference.
